description: Implementation of HalProxyCallback class methods for handling sensor events, including setting sub-hal index in sensor handles, processing events, and managing wake locks within Android sensor hardware abstraction layer.

classes.name: HalProxyCallbackBase
classes.description: Base class implementing callback handling for sensor events, including posting events and managing wake locks.

methods.name: setSubHalIndex
methods.description: Sets the sub-hal index as the first byte of the sensor handle.

methods.name: HalProxyCallbackBase::postEvents
methods.description: Processes and posts sensor events, asserting wake lock state based on event type.

methods.name: HalProxyCallbackBase::createScopedWakelock
methods.description: Creates a ScopedWakelock object, optionally locking it.

methods.name: HalProxyCallbackBase::processEvents
methods.description: Processes a list of events, setting sub-hal index and counting wake-up events.
